operative_clauses.original_operative_text: I hereby prescribe the following regulations governing the use of the Seals of the President and the Vice President of the United States:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SECTION 1. Except as otherwise provided by law, the knowing manufacture, reproduction, sale, or purchase for resale of the Seals or Coats of Arms of the President or the Vice President of the United States, or any likeness or substantial part thereof, shall be permitted only for the following uses:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Use by the President or Vice President of the United States;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Use in encyclopedias, dictionaries, books, journals, pamphlets, periodicals, or magazines incident to a description or history of seals, coats of arms, heraldry, or the Presidency or Vice Presidency. Such use shall be limited exclusively to the text, and any use of the Presidential or Vice Presidential Seal or Coat of Arms or any likeness or substantial part thereof on the cover of the above items is prohibited ;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) Use in libraries, museums, or educational facilities incident to descriptions or exhibits relating to seals, coats of arms, heraldry, or the Presidency or Vice Presidency;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) Use as an architectural embellishment in libraries, museums, or archives established to house the papers or effects of former Presidents or Vice Presidents;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (e) Use on a monument to a former President or Vice President;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(e)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (f) Use by way of photographic or electronic visual reproduction in pictures, moving pictures, or telecasts of bona fide news content;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(f)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (g) Such other uses for exceptional historical, educational, or newsworthy purposes as may be authorized in writing by the Counsel to the President.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1(g)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. The manufacture, reproduction, sale, or purchase for resale, either separately or appended to any article manufactured or sold, of the Seals of the President or Vice President, or any likeness or substantial part thereof, except as provided in this Order or as otherwise provided by law, is prohibited.
